notes.title: Final (hopefully) Playtest Version
notes.notes:
This build introduces a new menu system as well as options for Controller/Mouse sensitivity changes.

It also includes "object glinting" to highlight objects in the world that can be interacted with.
(Thanks Mikal)

notes.title: v0.51 - Controller Patch
notes.notes:
Immediate controller right stick sensitivity fix with the steam API 

(Hopefully last demo build)

notes.title: v.05 Update
notes.notes:
Should be approaching the last few versions of the playtest build - 

- Fixed bugs
- Increased optimisation
- Enabled joysticks to scroll through menus
- enabled ability to change the glyphs in menus
- added story hints mode
- extended ch2 a little bit to truly demonstrate choices

notes.title: NWJS v2
notes.notes: Added some suggestions thanks to sushiki

notes.title: NWJS Build
notes.notes:
This new build uses NWJS instead of WebView, it also has changed the mp4 format to webm, as some machines had a problem with running mp4 videos.

Also included:
* Steam overlay fixed and working
* Ability to Change Resolution
* Optimisations
* Saving settings files to your user folder
